content.question: How does group normalization work?
options: It normalizes each output of the network separately after training.
It computes one shared statistic for the entire dataset.
It normalizes the raw input data before it enters the network.
It divides the channels of a layer into groups and computes normalization statistics within each group.
content.answer: It divides the channels of a layer into groups and computes normalization statistics within each group.
